$Comment: The Flaming Horseman's Helm, one of the six pieces of the Flaming Hallowed set the Horseman's Hoard can pay (ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase.json) and the stronger twin of the plain Horseman's Helm, whose model it shares in its gold texture (Items/Hallows_Eve/Horseman_Armor/); its icon is drawn from that model by tools/derive_art.py. A member of the Hallowed set (ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.json) and of the Flaming Hallowed set (Hallows_Eve_Flaming_Hallowed.json), where it takes the head slot as the Burning Jack Helm does, so either helm with his three flaming pieces makes that set's four. CosmeticsToHide clears ears, hair, beard and face accessories, since the helm closes over the whole head. Its armour is the game's ancient steel helm's numbers (the same Physical and Projectile resistance and Health), with its recipe left out (it is never crafted) and twice that piece's durability (150). On top of that it wards off Fire (DamageResistance.Fire, the Burning Jack Helm's shape, 0.06 is 6%) and raises DamageBonus_Fire, Ziggfreed's CommonLib's stat for Fire damage the wearer deals, in whole percent points, so a Lantern Bomb or any fire weapon hits 8% harder with it on. Light is the hotter glow of the Burning Jack Helm. An Armor block written here replaces a parent's whole, so the file restates every leaf rather than naming a parent.
